summary: Skyasterix reveals the skill set and inspiration perks for Lariel, an upcoming Season 9 Corrosion support hero in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. In Chinese server testing against Temporal Vortex, a Corrosion team featuring Lariel, Rook, Sintrellia, Blah Blah, and Sleight achieved over 32.3 billion damage. Lariel functions as a powerful buffer and debuffer through his unique Tear mechanic, making him a major meta booster for Rook rather than a standalone main DPS.

heroes.name: Lariel
heroes.note: Applies DEF-reducing Tear stacks and amplifies Corrosion school damage, enabling Rook to reach unprecedented Temporal Vortex scores.

heroes.name: Rook
heroes.note: Re-enters top meta status when paired with Lariel, contributing over 80% of team damage in high-tier boss battles.

heroes.name: Sintrellia
heroes.note: Essential piece for optimal Corrosion compositions alongside Rook and Lariel.

teams.note: Achieved over 32.3 billion damage in Chinese server testing by combining Lariel's Tear debuffs and Rook's massive burst output.

meta_changes: Lariel introduces the Tear debuff (stackable DEF reduction up to 10 stacks) and restores Corrosion teams and Rook to the top of the endgame Temporal Vortex meta.
tips: Treat Lariel as a team buffer and enabler rather than a primary DPS unit, as his primary role is enabling Rook.
Unlocking Lariel's Inspiration 2 (I2) grants Corrosion allies an additional 5% damage bonus against targets inflicted with Ruminate.
title: 🐉 S9 100% META BOOSTER FOR ROOK?! 😱 New CORROSION HERO Skills Revealed! | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
